headline: Certifying the 2026 Fitchburg Municipal Election, after reviewing UOCAVA, late, and provisional ballots.
summary: Ballots up for review are UOCAVA ballots, ballots received after 5:00 PM on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, and provisional ballots. The agenda also includes a vote to certify the election results.
items: Review ballots received after 5:00 PM on Tuesday, November 3, 2026
Vote to certify the 2026 Fitchburg Municipal Election
